decisions.summary: MoonWitness is the rigorous system layer; ROCKSOUL is deliberate human intervention.
Graph semantics use geometry and line treatment so meaning survives grayscale.
Brand, Signal and Critical Crimson remain distinct semantic roles.
Deprecated assets remain discoverable but require replacements and are excluded from production eligibility.
Generated migration outputs have one writer authority; audit validation is check-only.
Visual System 2.0 top-level doctrine is frozen after v1.7.0; exceptional changes require freeze-break evidence.
